legacy_all.label: Legacy All
legacy_all.description: Full route-wide tracker for imported or rough split sets.
legacy_all.note: Use this catch-all view when the split list has not been cleaned into stronger region markers yet.
legacy_all.objectiveNote: Track every objective bucket at once and use this as the safety net while the late route is still being refined.

cascades.label: Cascades
cascades.description: Open with Copeland, cemetery cleanup, and the first NERO chain.
cascades.note: Early route density is high here: checkpoints, nests, route pickups, and the first IPCA pieces all overlap.
cascades.objectiveNote: Front-load route pickups, NERO clears, and corpse looting while the map is still compact. This is the cleanest section to stay ahead on collectibles and checklist pace.

belknap.label: Belknap
belknap.description: Push Hot Springs trust and clear the first Tucker-side loops.
belknap.note: Belknap is where the route starts stacking jobs, tourism, intel, and checkpoint value at the same time.
belknap.objectiveNote: Use this phase to build Tucker progress fast. Keep jobs, checkpoints, and route pickups moving together so trust and credits do not lag behind the story.

lost_lake.label: Lost Lake
lost_lake.description: The long midgame grind of jobs, hordes, songs, and map cleanup.
lost_lake.note: Most of the route's density lives here. This phase is doing the heavy lifting for trust, credits, songs, and route-wide progress.
lost_lake.objectiveNote: Keep Iron Mike strong: this is the best phase to push the 20k camp spend setup, start horde momentum for late skills, and bank a huge share of the collectible route.

iron_butte.label: Iron Butte
iron_butte.description: Short, dangerous stretch with sermon-heavy cleanup and escape routing.
iron_butte.note: The source notes are conservative in Iron Butte, so treat every sermon, cairn, and route pickup here as high priority.
iron_butte.objectiveNote: Do not assume you can remember Iron Butte cleanup later. This phase is where the route wants the R.I.P. sermon spike and the messiest one-off pickups locked in.

crater_lake.label: Crater Lake
crater_lake.description: Diamond Lake and Wizard Island with heavier story pacing and tighter NERO loops.
crater_lake.note: Crater Lake is more story-driven, but it quietly sets up the bike, trust, and checkpoint state you need for smooth late cleanup.
crater_lake.objectiveNote: Stay on story rhythm, but keep Diamond Lake and Wizard Island productive. This is the bridge into late-game trust, bike spend, and the last big NERO sweep.

highway_97.label: Highway 97
highway_97.description: Late-game cleanup through Highway 97 and the loosest notes in the current route set.
highway_97.note: Treat this as controlled cleanup with room for post-story mop-up. The route source is weakest here, so expect a manual finish pass.
highway_97.objectiveNote: Use Highway 97 as the cleanup bridge into full 100% mop-up: finish the route totals, then expect the remaining trust, 45 skills, 989 ears, 541 corpse loot, and any missing full-collectible categories to settle here or just after story end.
